29:23.note: Plus 'before the Lord' and 'before the people of Israel'.

29:25.note: Instruments recast as 'praises'; Gad and Nathan as 'prophets of king David'; final clause paraphrased.

29:27.note: Plus 'Hezekiah began to praise'; trumpets omitted.

29:28.note: Plus 'of Israel'; Ketiv/Qere of mhssrym rendered once.

29:31.note: 'Since you have drawn near to the way of the Lord' for 'filled your hand'; burnt offerings as 'were bringing'.

29:34.note: 'Minister to' for flay; 'humble in heart' for 'upright in heart'.

29:36.note: Plus 'of Israel'; 'that the work of the house was completed' for 'what God had prepared for the people'.

30:1.note: Plus 'mighty' (God); 'house of' added to tribe names.

30:2.note: Plus 'of Israel who were' and 'to the Lord God of Israel'.

30:3.note: Plus 'teachers of' the people; lemadday omitted.

30:5.note: Final clause rendered 'because their wealth was very great' for 'they had not kept it in great number as written'.

30:6.note: 'From you' for 'to you'; 'the king' singular for kings of Assyria.

30:7.note: 'Curse' for desolation; 'our fathers' for their fathers.

30:9.note: Free: 'since it was revealed upon you and your brothers and sons, he will give you mercy' for 'if you return, your brothers will find compassion'.

30:11.note: Plus 'wicked', tribe of Ephraim, and 'the rest of these tribes'.

30:14.note: 'All the burnt offerings of idols' for incense altars.

30:16.note: 'Man of God' as 'prophet of the Lord'; priests 'received' rather than sprinkled the blood.

30:17.note: Plus 'stood for them'; positive 'whoever was clean' for 'not clean'.

30:18.note: Plus 'these four tribes' and 'all the people of Israel'.

30:19.note: 'Our heart ... to pray to the Lord' for 'every heart to seek God'.

30:21.note: 'Praises of their mouth' for 'instruments of strength'.

30:22.note: 'Praised good praises before the Lord' for 'showed good understanding'; plus 'men'.

30:24.note: Gift recast as '7000 animals, large and small'; 'the princes' omitted from second gift.

31:1.note: Asherim rendered nmr' (?); plus 'they came and entered in peace'; 'until all destroyed' recast as 'until Israel returned'.

31:2.note: Word-for-word; 'gate of the Lord' for 'gates of the camps of the Lord'.

31:3.note: Plus 'of bulls' and 'he said to the people'.

31:6.note: Syriac repeats the list of firstfruits from v. 5; cattle, sheep and heaps omitted.

31:7.note: Heaps rendered 'a great abundance of firstfruits'; 'to lay the foundation' and 'finished' omitted.

31:8.note: Plus 'Hezekiah took and divided it to priests and Levites'; plus 'prayed'.

31:10.note: Speaker confused (said to Azariah); plus 'give the rest to the poor and needy' and 'to all Israel'.

31:14.note: Plus 'gate', 'had authority'; 'to give the contribution' omitted.

31:17.note: Plus 'oil and wine were given' for enrollment.

31:19.note: Plus 'their flesh was holy; they did not approach women and went about'; pasture fields omitted.

32:1.note: Plus 'which Hezekiah did'; 'said to their inhabitants: accept (my) right hand and come to me' for 'thought to break into them'.

32:2.note: 'His armies' for 'his face'; plus 'king of Assyria'.

32:4.note: Plus 'of Israel'; 'the great rivers' for the overflowing brook; singular 'king'.

32:5.note: Jussive forms; 'filled up the trench which David made' for Millo; towers and 'broken' omitted; plus 'spears'.

32:7.note: 'Armies that came with him' for 'all the multitude'.

32:9.note: Plus 'Rabshakeh came'; 'against Hezekiah king of Judah' omitted.

32:12.note: 'Where is this Hezekiah' for 'is it not'; high places rendered 'burnt offerings'.

32:13.note: Rhetorical question rendered as statement 'they could not'.

32:14.note: 'The Lord' for 'your God'; 'their cities' for 'his people'.

32:15.note: Plus a first 'your God cannot save you'; 'their cities' for 'his people'.

32:17.note: Plus 'to the people of Israel'; 'their/his cities' for 'people'.

32:19.note: Order inverted; plus 'who rules in Jerusalem, that he deliver them'.

32:20.note: 'The Lord heard the voice of their prayer' for 'cried to heaven'; 'the king' omitted.

32:21.note: 'Kings' for leaders; plus 'from before him', 'king of Assyria'; Ketiv/Qere of 'those who came forth' rendered once.

32:22.note: 'All their border enemies' for 'all'; 'guided them on every side' omitted.

32:23.note: Plus 'of the sons of Israel'; 'were giving'.

32:24.note: Divine speech recast as Hezekiah's prayer 'you did many mighty deeds for me'.

32:25.note: Hezekiah's prayer continues: 'not according to the work of my hands'; plus 'this is why Hezekiah fell sick'.

32:31.note: Babylonian envoys and testing omitted; plus 'he followed the law of the Lord as it was given'.

32:33.note: 'City of David' for 'ascent of the tombs of the sons of David'; plus 'returned to Jerusalem'.

33:1.note: Word-for-word; 'when he arose in the kingdom'.

33:3.note: 'Altars' for high places; 'burnt offerings to idols' for altars to Baals; 'served them' omitted.

33:5.note: Syriac lacks v. 4 and the first half of v. 5.

33:6.note: 'In the great valley' for Ben-Hinnom; 'inquired of Chaldeans' for 'appointed ghosts'; 'his son' singular.

33:7.note: 'Image of four faces' for the carved image; 'my Shekinah' for 'my name'.

33:8.note: 'Make Israel go out from this land'; 'by Moses' as 'which my servant Moses commanded them'.

33:9.note: 'Like the peoples' for 'more than the nations'.

33:12.note: 'Prayed before' for 'entreated the face of'; 'feared' for 'humbled himself'.

33:14.note: 'Encircled all Jerusalem with an outer wall' for 'around Ophel'; 'high cities' for fortified.

33:16.note: Ketiv/Qere wykn/wybn rendered once; plus 'burnt offerings'.

33:17.note: Recast as command: 'no more feasts and other sacrifices on high places shall you offer, but before the Lord your God'.

33:19.note: 'Priests' (kumre) for Asherim; 'Hanan the prophet' for Hozai; 'before he humbled himself' omitted.

33:22.note: 'Images and idols' for carved images; 'worshipped' for 'served them'.

33:23.note: Plus 'his God'; repeats 'before the Lord his God'.

34:3.note: 'To pray to the God' for 'to seek'; extended list of cult objects.

34:4.note: Altars of Baals and sun-pillars omitted; plus 'their dust', 'of men'.

34:5.note: Plus 'who served them; he took them out of their graves and brought'; 'on their altars' omitted.

34:6.note: 'In their streets' renders Ketiv/Qere 'in their ruins'.

34:7.note: Asherim and sun-pillars omitted; plus 'like dust and scattered them'.

34:8.note: Joah omitted; plus 'said to them: go'; 'scribe of the city' for governor.

34:9.note: 'Inhabitants of Jerusalem' follows Ketiv; plus 'hand of the people'.

34:12.note: 'Praisers' for 'to direct'; 'praising with instruments of praise'.

34:16.note: Plus 'Shaphan said to the king all that Hilkiah told him'.

34:20.note: 'Achbor' for Abdon; 'chief of the king' for 'servant of the king'.

34:22.note: Plus 'all whom the king sent'; 'in learning' for 'in the second quarter'; 'keeper of vessels'.

34:23.note: 'Lord of lords of Israel' for 'Lord God of Israel'.

34:25.note: 'Feared other gods' for 'burned incense'; Ketiv/Qere rendered once.

34:31.note: 'Swore an oath' for 'made the covenant'; plus 'to walk in his ways'.

34:32.note: 'Passed into the covenant of the Lord God' for 'did according to the covenant of God'.

34:33.note: 'Hateful works which the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel'; 'all his days' omitted.

35:1.note: 'Feast' for Passover; 'kept the feast' for 'slaughtered the Passover'.

35:3.note: 'Who stand over all Israel' for 'who taught'; imperative 'sanctify yourselves'; Ketiv/Qere rendered once.

35:4.note: 'Prepare your heart and the heart of your fathers' for 'by your fathers' houses'; divisions omitted.

35:6.note: 'With your brothers' for 'by the hand of Moses'; plus 'the heart of'.

35:9.note: 'Son of his brother' for Nethanel his brother; Jozabad and 'officers of the Levites' omitted; plus 'sheep'.

35:10.note: 'According to the king's command' moved to v. 11.

35:11.note: 'As the king commanded' taken from v. 10; 'from the blood' for 'from their hand'.

35:12.note: 'Every morning' reads laboqer for labaqar; 'removed' omitted.

35:13.note: Plus 'in fire' with the holy offerings.

35:15.note: 'Gathered' reads w'sp (Asaph) as verb; 'who minister' for singers; 'Levites' omitted.

35:18.note: 'Feast' for Passover (first); inhabitants of Jerusalem condensed.

35:20.note: 'Pharaoh the lame' for Necho; 'Mabbug' for Carchemish; 'his armies of the house' (?).

35:21.note: Repetitive paraphrase; 'the Lord' for God; plus 'king of Judah' repeated.

35:22.note: 'Went' for 'disguised himself'; plus 'Josiah did not know that it was from the Lord'; 'Pharaoh the lame' for Necho.

35:23.note: Plus 'two arrows'; 'struck with a deadly blow' for 'badly wounded'.

35:25.note: 'Righteous men and women' for singers; plus 'weeping'.

36:2.note: Word-for-word; 'when he arose in the kingdom'.

36:3.note: 'In Jerusalem' and the tribute clause omitted.

36:4.note: 'Pharaoh the lame' for Necho; 'king of Egypt' (subject) omitted; plus 'and he died there'.

36:8.note: 'Hateful things' for abominations; 'what was found against him' omitted.

36:9.note: Age 18 for MT 8; reign '100 days' for 'three months and ten days'.

36:10.note: 'His uncle' for 'his brother'; plus 'against him', 'which were'.

36:13.note: 'Did not want to pray before the Lord' for 'from turning to the Lord'.

36:14.note: 'Elders of the priests' for chiefs; plus 'and of the Levites'.

36:15.note: 'The flock of his pasture' for 'his dwelling place'.

36:17.note: Plus 'not even on sucklings of milk' for 'aged'; Ketiv/Qere Chaldeans rendered once.

36:22.note: Plus 'the prophet'; 'it was said in his name'.

36:23.note: 'Whoever wills, let him go up and come to me' for 'the Lord his God be with him; let him go up'.
